name: VoltLab
summary: An interactive electricity lab for school and university physics. Students build and vary circuits, follow narrated lessons and answer quizzes with worked solutions. Free content plus a paid Pro upgrade; there's also a free browser demo.

value: Self-study of electricity with lessons and quizzes

value.from: Free; VoltLab Pro from US$3.99 a month (App Store)
value.notes: App Store in-app purchases (US store, 24 Nov 2026): VoltLab Pro US$39.99; Pro one year US$19.99 or US$6.99; Pro one month US$3.99. The developer says teachers can use all educational material free; how that works is being confirmed.
App Store privacy label: Data Not Collected (developer's own declaration).

researchTasks: Platforms: iOS app (iOS 15 or later) and a browser demo at https://voltlab.club/?section=law-demo&preset=series-circuit-law. Check Android and desktop availability.
Asked for a Pro reviewer code; reviewer access is demo only until then, so it stays profiled, not evaluated.
Ask: teacher access terms, whether teachers can see student progress, privacy policy and under-13 use, languages.
Deployment is our reading (a downloadable app plus web demo; works offline); confirm.

dataGaps.note: No LTI, SCORM or classroom integrations stated.
